author: I_cy
body: Hello my name is Icy_Farts and I was banned for Ban evasion on April 16. I loved playing on your server and I promise I will cause no harm at all to your server. I really love Avicus and I have always enjoyed playing on it. Could I please be unbanned.<br id="null">                                                                           Thanks, Icy

replies.author: faht
replies.body:
I'm sorry to say this, but this appeal is denied. We do not allow people that ban evade multiple times come back to the server. I understand that you're sorry for your actions, but you have to face the consequences. 

Regards,
Jiveh
